statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
The service rendered was Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The diagnoses documented on the claim are R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial is based on the required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered.
